overclaims: The February 9 review roundup corroborates reception within the target period; its timing relative to Marcus's post that day is unknown.
Microsoft demonstrated Bing on February 7 and Google presented Bard in Paris on February 8.
checks.note: The limitation calls the Newser roundup's timing relative to Marcus's post unknown, but the evidence gives it: Newser was posted Feb 9, 11:07 AM CST (17:07Z), about 12 hours after the post (05:06Z). So it postdates the post, though it summarizes Roose's earlier column. Also, the e3 excerpts shown list multisearch, Maps and Translate at Paris and call Bard 'still silent'. They don't show that Google 'presented Bard' in Paris. Excerpt, proposition, outcome and citations are fine.
